candidates.description: getWalletBalance queries WalletModel using req.body.UserId directly without verifying it matches the authenticated user, allowing any caller to read any user's wallet balance.
candidates.rationale: Line 12 uses req.body.UserId as the sole filter with no comparison to the authenticated identity. The route registration in server.ts does not show security.isAuthorized() or appendUserId() middleware for /rest/wallet/balance. Verification: authenticate as user A, request balance with user B's UserId, confirm B's balance is returned.
candidates.title: IDOR on wallet balance read via unvalidated UserId

candidates.description: addWalletBalance increments balance for req.body.UserId without verifying the caller owns that account, enabling arbitrary balance manipulation on any user.
candidates.rationale: Line 27 calls WalletModel.increment with req.body.UserId as the where clause. No middleware or handler logic ties the operation to the authenticated session. Verification: authenticate as user A, POST to /rest/wallet/add with user B's UserId and a balance value, confirm B's balance changes.
candidates.title: IDOR on wallet balance modification via unvalidated UserId

candidates.description: verifyImageCaptcha calls next() when captchas[0] is falsy, so an attacker who never requests a captcha or waits for expiry can bypass the check entirely.
candidates.rationale: Line 52 condition `!captchas[0] || req.body.answer === captchas[0].answer` passes when no captcha row is found for the user within 5 minutes. Verification: authenticate, skip requesting a captcha, submit a feedback POST with an arbitrary answer value, confirm the request proceeds past captcha verification.
candidates.title: Captcha verification bypassed when no captcha record exists

candidates.description: profileImageUrlUpload fetches req.body.imageUrl with no host or protocol validation, allowing the server to be coerced into requesting internal or attacker-controlled endpoints.
candidates.rationale: Line 24 calls fetch(url) where url originates from req.body.imageUrl (line 19). No allowlist, protocol check, or private-IP block is present. The route is registered at server.ts:330 with only uploadToMemory middleware. Verification: POST /profile/image/url with imageUrl pointing to an internal metadata endpoint, observe server-side request in logs or response timing.
candidates.title: Server-side request forgery via user-controlled imageUrl in profile upload

candidates.description: changePassword only validates the current password when query.current is truthy; an empty or missing current parameter bypasses the check and allows password change with only a valid token.
candidates.rationale: Line 39: `if (currentPassword && security.hash(currentPassword) !== loggedInUser.data.password)` short-circuits when currentPassword is '' or undefined, skipping the comparison. Verification: obtain a valid token, call GET /rest/user/change-password?new=X&repeat=X (omit current), confirm password is updated without knowing the old one.
candidates.title: Current-password check skipped when query parameter is falsy
